svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 1440 commits across five public projects, 77 active days, peak 207 commits per day. 2026-07-17 through 2026-10-08 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-10-08T19:22:31.000Z.
